## Load Functions
### 1) Process data
```{r}
# load packages
#library(tidyverse)
#library(Biostrings)
#library(pwalign)

# ============================================================
# Convert aligned reference/query strings into mutation blocks
# ============================================================

call_mutations_from_alignment <- function(
    aligned_ref,
    aligned_query,
    level = c("nt", "aa"),
    protein = NULL
) {
  
  level <- match.arg(level)
  
  ref_chars <- strsplit(aligned_ref, "")[[1]]
  query_chars <- strsplit(aligned_query, "")[[1]]
  
  if (length(ref_chars) != length(query_chars)) {
    stop("Aligned reference and query must have the same length.")
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Track reference and query coordinates across alignment
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ref_pos <- integer(length(ref_chars))
  query_pos <- integer(length(query_chars))
  
  r <- 0L
  q <- 0L
  
  for (i in seq_along(ref_chars)) {
    
    if (ref_chars[i] != "-") {
      r <- r + 1L
      ref_pos[i] <- r
    } else {
      ref_pos[i] <- r
    }
    
    if (query_chars[i] != "-") {
      q <- q + 1L
      query_pos[i] <- q
    } else {
      query_pos[i] <- q
    }
  }
  
  
  alignment_tbl <- tibble(
    alignment_position = seq_along(ref_chars),
    ref_char = ref_chars,
    query_char = query_chars,
    ref_position = ref_pos,
    query_position = query_pos
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      event = dplyr::case_when(
        
        ref_char == query_char ~ "match",
        
        ref_char != "-" &
          query_char != "-" ~ "substitution",
        
        ref_char != "-" &
          query_char == "-" ~ "deletion",
        
        ref_char == "-" &
          query_char != "-" ~ "insertion",
        
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      )
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Substitutions
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  substitutions <- alignment_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(event == "substitution") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      mutation_type = "substitution",
      
      ref_start = ref_position,
      ref_end = ref_position,
      
      query_start = query_position,
      query_end = query_position,
      
      ref_allele = ref_char,
      alt_allele = query_char
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Group contiguous indels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  indel_tbl <- alignment_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(event %in% c("insertion", "deletion"))
  
  if (nrow(indel_tbl) > 0) {
    
    #indel_tbl <- indel_tbl %>%
      #dplyr::mutate(
        #new_block =
          #event != dplyr::lag(event, default = first(event)) |
          #alignment_position !=
            #dplyr::lag(
              #alignment_position,
              #default = first(alignment_position)
            #) + 1,
        
        #block_id = cumsum(new_block)
      #)
    
    indel_tbl <- indel_tbl %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          
          new_block =
            dplyr::row_number() == 1L |
            event != dplyr::lag(event) |
            alignment_position !=
              dplyr::lag(alignment_position) + 1L,
          
          block_id = cumsum(new_block)
        )
    
    indels <- indel_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(event, block_id) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        
        ref_start = min(ref_position),
        ref_end = max(ref_position),
        
        query_start = min(query_position),
        query_end = max(query_position),
        
        ref_allele = paste0(
          ref_char[ref_char != "-"],
          collapse = ""
        ),
        
        alt_allele = paste0(
          query_char[query_char != "-"],
          collapse = ""
        ),
        
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        mutation_type = event
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        mutation_type,
        ref_start,
        ref_end,
        query_start,
        query_end,
        ref_allele,
        alt_allele
      )
    
  } else {
    
    indels <- tibble(
      mutation_type = character(),
      ref_start = integer(),
      ref_end = integer(),
      query_start = integer(),
      query_end = integer(),
      ref_allele = character(),
      alt_allele = character()
    )
  }
  
  
  mutations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    substitutions,
    indels
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      ref_start,
      query_start
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add mutation IDs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (level == "nt") {
    
    mutations <- mutations %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        
        mutation_id = dplyr::case_when(
          
          mutation_type == "substitution" ~
            paste0(
              ref_allele,
              ref_start,
              alt_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" &
            ref_start == ref_end ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_end,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "insertion" ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_start + 1L,
              "ins",
              alt_allele
            )
        ),
        
        mutation_id_full = paste0(
          "nt_",
          mutation_id
        )
      )
    
  } else {
    
    if (is.null(protein)) {
      stop("protein must be supplied for amino-acid mutations.")
    }
    
    mutations <- mutations %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        
        mutation_id = dplyr::case_when(
          
          mutation_type == "substitution" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_allele,
              ref_start,
              alt_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" &
            ref_start == ref_end ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_end,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "insertion" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_start + 1L,
              "ins",
              alt_allele
            )
        )
      )
  }
  
  
  list(
    mutations = mutations,
    coordinate_map = alignment_tbl
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Align one Evo genome against WT and call nucleotide mutations
# ============================================================

align_and_call_nt_mutations <- function(
    reference_sequence,
    query_sequence,
    isolate,
    accession_version = NA_character_
) {
  
  reference_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", reference_sequence)
  )
  
  query_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", query_sequence)
  )
  
  
  ref <- Biostrings::DNAString(reference_sequence)
  query <- Biostrings::DNAString(query_sequence)
  
  
  nt_matrix <- pwalign::nucleotideSubstitutionMatrix(
    match = 2,
    mismatch = -3,
    baseOnly = TRUE
  )
  
  
  aln <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    pattern = query,
    subject = ref,
    type = "global",
    substitutionMatrix = nt_matrix,
    gapOpening = 5,
    gapExtension = 2
  )
  
  
  # subject = WT
  # pattern = Evo
  
  aligned_ref <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedSubject(aln)
  )
  
  aligned_query <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedPattern(aln)
  )
  
  
  calls <- call_mutations_from_alignment(
    aligned_ref = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    level = "nt"
  )
  
  
  mutations <- calls$mutations %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  coordinate_map <- calls$coordinate_map %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  qc <- tibble(
    isolate = isolate,
    accession_version = accession_version,
    
    reference_length = nchar(reference_sequence),
    query_length = nchar(query_sequence),
    aligned_length = nchar(aligned_ref),
    
    alignment_score = as.numeric(
      BiocGenerics::score(aln)
    ),
    
    n_substitutions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "substitution"
    ),
    
    n_insertions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "insertion"
    ),
    
    n_deletions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "deletion"
    ),
    
    inserted_nt = sum(
      nchar(
        mutations$alt_allele[
          mutations$mutation_type == "insertion"
        ]
      )
    ),
    
    deleted_nt = sum(
      nchar(
        mutations$ref_allele[
          mutations$mutation_type == "deletion"
        ]
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  list(
    alignment = aln,
    aligned_reference = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    coordinate_map = coordinate_map,
    mutations = mutations,
    QC = qc
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: Run Spearman correlations in EVO analyses
# ============================================================

run_spearman_one <- function(
    data,
    predictor,
    outcome = "lytic_rank_Evo"
) {

  df <-
    data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      x = dplyr::all_of(predictor),
      y = dplyr::all_of(outcome)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()


  test <-
    stats::cor.test(
      df$x,
      df$y,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )


  tibble::tibble(

    predictor =
      predictor,

    n =
      nrow(df),

    rho =
      unname(
        test$estimate
      ),

    p_value =
      test$p.value
  )
}
```

### 2) Plotting
```{r}
# Function to make heatmaps 
build_mutation_heatmap_data <- function(
    genome_metadata,
    mutation_data,
    rescue_changes = NULL,
    rescue_annotation = NULL
) {

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Genome metadata
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  genomes <- genome_metadata %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      viability_state =
        dplyr::case_when(

          viability_group == "Nonviable" ~
            "Nonviable",

          acquired_mutations_during_rebooting ~
            "Viable after rescue",

          rebooting_viable ~
            "Viable",

          TRUE ~
            "Other"
        )
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Add rescue annotations when available
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(rescue_annotation)) {

    genomes <- genomes %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        rescue_annotation %>%
          dplyr::select(
            original_design_id,
            pure_SNV_rescue,
            single_SNV_rescue,
            n_rebooting_SNV_changes,
            n_rebooting_indel_changes
          ),
        by = "original_design_id",
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )

  } else {

    genomes <- genomes %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        pure_SNV_rescue = FALSE,
        single_SNV_rescue = FALSE,
        n_rebooting_SNV_changes = 0L,
        n_rebooting_indel_changes = 0L
      )
  }


  genomes <- genomes %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      pure_SNV_rescue =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          pure_SNV_rescue,
          FALSE
        ),

      single_SNV_rescue =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          single_SNV_rescue,
          FALSE
        ),

      # concise row labels
      heatmap_label =
        dplyr::case_when(

          single_SNV_rescue ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable after rescue | 1 SNV"
            ),

          viability_state ==
            "Viable after rescue" ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable after rescue"
            ),

          viability_state ==
            "Viable" ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable"
            ),

          TRUE ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Nonviable"
            )
        ),

      viability_state =
        factor(
          viability_state,
          levels = c(
            "Nonviable",
            "Viable after rescue",
            "Viable"
          )
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      viability_state,
      isolate
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Designed detrimental/lethal substitutions
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  designed_focus <- mutation_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      mutation_type == "substitution",
      DMS_effect_category %in%
        c(
          "Detrimental",
          "Lethal"
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genome_position_numeric =
        as.integer(genome_position)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      original_design_id,
      mutation_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Rescue events belonging to genomes in this subset
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(rescue_changes)) {

    rescue_subset <- rescue_changes %>%
      dplyr::semi_join(
        genomes %>%
          dplyr::select(
            original_design_id
          ),
        by = "original_design_id"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(

        plot_mutation_id =
          dplyr::case_when(

            rebooting_change ==
              "Reversion to WT" ~
              designed_mutation_id,

            rebooting_change %in%
              c(
                "New mutation",
                "Changed allele"
              ) ~
              recovered_mutation_id,

            TRUE ~
              NA_character_
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(plot_mutation_id)
      )

  } else {

    rescue_subset <- tibble::tibble(
      original_design_id = character(),
      isolate = character(),
      genome_position = integer(),
      rebooting_change = character(),
      plot_mutation_id = character()
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation universe:
  # designed damaging mutations + rescue mutations
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  mutation_axis <- dplyr::bind_rows(

    designed_focus %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        mutation_id,
        genome_position_numeric
      ),

    rescue_subset %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        mutation_id =
          plot_mutation_id,

        genome_position_numeric =
          as.integer(
            genome_position
          )
      )
  ) %>%

    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(mutation_id),
      !is.na(genome_position_numeric)
    ) %>%

    dplyr::distinct(
      mutation_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%

    dplyr::arrange(
      genome_position_numeric,
      mutation_id
    )


  mutation_order <-
    mutation_axis$mutation_id

  genome_order <-
    genomes$heatmap_label


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Build complete genome × mutation matrix
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  heatmap <- tidyr::crossing(

    original_design_id =
      genomes$original_design_id,

    mutation_id =
      mutation_order
  ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      genomes %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          isolate,
          heatmap_label,
          viability_state,
          dplyr::any_of(
            c(
              "has_indel",
              "n_indel_events",
              "single_SNV_rescue"
            )
          )
        ),
      by = "original_design_id",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      designed_focus %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          mutation_id,
          DMS_effect_category
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(),
      by = c(
        "original_design_id",
        "mutation_id"
      ),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      heatmap_category =
        dplyr::case_when(

          DMS_effect_category ==
            "Lethal" ~
            "Lethal",

          DMS_effect_category ==
            "Detrimental" ~
            "Detrimental",

          TRUE ~
            "Absent"
        ),

      mutation_id =
        factor(
          mutation_id,
          levels =
            mutation_order
        ),

      heatmap_label =
        factor(
          heatmap_label,
          levels =
            genome_order
        )
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare rescue overlay
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  rescue_overlay <- rescue_subset %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      genomes %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          heatmap_label,
          single_SNV_rescue
        ),
      by = "original_design_id",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      plot_mutation_id =
        factor(
          plot_mutation_id,
          levels =
            mutation_order
        ),

      heatmap_label =
        factor(
          heatmap_label,
          levels =
            genome_order
        )
    )


  list(
    genomes = genomes,
    mutation_axis = mutation_axis,
    heatmap = heatmap,
    rescue_overlay = rescue_overlay
  )
}




```





## Process Evo 300 candidate genomes
Mutation calling in Evo 300 genomes, and compare mutations in Viable vs. Non-viable

### 1) load genomes and metadata
Evo 300 genomes metadata preparation.
 - Sheet 1. Generated bacteriophage genome candidates, metrics, assembly fragments, and viability.
 - Sheet 5. Top 10 nucleotide BLAST hits and mutation metrics for viable generated, nonviable generated, and natural bacteriophage genomes. 
   - Sheet 5 doesnt have the original design id rather a Query column that mixes viable phages id with designed id for nonviable phages, so to merge BLAST results in sheet 5 back to sheet 1, we can use isolate id + viability.
   
- evo300_metadata_final

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Load all 302 Evo-designed genomes (Sheet 1. Generated bacteriophage genome candidates, metrics, assembly fragments, and viability.)
# ============================================================

## Read Sheet 1 from the supplementary Excel file
library(readxl)

evo_supplement_file <-
  "./codes_Github_final/data/Generative design of bacteriophages with genome language models/science.aec2657_data_s1.xlsx"

excel_sheets(evo_supplement_file)

evo_sheet1_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  evo_supplement_file,
  sheet = 2
)

head(evo_sheet1_raw, 5)
nrow(evo_sheet1_raw)
# [1] 302

evo_sheet1_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    n_unique_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        synthesisbatch_model_parameters_prompt_id
      )
  )

evo_sheet1_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    n_unique_sequences = dplyr::n_distinct(sequence),
    n_duplicate_sequences = n_rows - n_unique_sequences
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 3
#   n_rows n_unique_sequences n_duplicate_sequences
#    <int>              <int>                 <int>
# 1    302                296                     6

evo_sheet1_raw %>%
  dplyr::count(
    post_rebooting_viability,
    sort = TRUE
  )
# # A tibble: 4 × 2
#   post_rebooting_viability                          n
#   <chr>                                         <int>
# 1 nonviable                                       269
# 2 nonviable, failed DNA synthesis                  17
# 3 viable                                            9
# 4 viable, acquired mutation(s) during rebooting     7

evo_sheet1_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl(
      "^viable",
      post_rebooting_viability
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    synthesisbatch_model_parameters_prompt_id,
    post_rebooting_viability,
    genome_length,
    mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

summary(
  evo_sheet1_raw$mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174
)
#    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#   60.19   80.69   91.06   87.88   94.99  100.00 

summary(
  evo_sheet1_raw$genome_length
)
#   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#   4117    5386    5454    5477    5670    5998 



# ============================================================
# Load Top 10 nucleotide BLAST hits and mutation metrics for viable generated, nonviable generated, and natural bacteriophage genomes. (Sheet 5)
# ============================================================

evo_sheet5_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  evo_supplement_file,
  sheet = 6
)

head(evo_sheet5_raw, 5)
nrow(evo_sheet5_raw)
# [1] 4910

evo_sheet5_top1 <- evo_sheet5_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    `Hit Rank` == 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    # Standardize Query names:
    # Evo-Φ4 -> Evo-Phi4
    isolate = stringr::str_replace_all(
      Query,
      "\u03a6",
      "Phi"
    ),

    category_original = Category
  )

evo_sheet5_top1 %>%
  dplyr::count(
    category_original,
    sort = TRUE
  )

# # A tibble: 5 × 2
#   category_original             n
#   <chr>                     <int>
# 1 Nonviable generated         286
# 2 ΦX174 variant               134
# 3 Lab-evolved ΦX174 variant    39
# 4 Viable generated             16
# 5 ΦX174-like isolate           16

# Confirmed no duplicated generated isolate names
evo_sheet5_top1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(
      category_original,
      "generated"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    isolate,
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 1
  )

evo_nearest_natural_top1 <- evo_sheet5_top1 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(

    category_original,

    query_original = Query,
    isolate,

    nearest_natural_accession =
      Accession,

    nearest_natural_description =
      Description,

    nearest_natural_percent_identity =
      `Percent Identity`,

    nearest_natural_sequence_similarity =
      sequence_similarity,

    nearest_natural_query_coverage =
      `Query Cover %`,

    nearest_natural_alignment_length =
      `Alignment Length`,

    nearest_natural_subject_length =
      `Subject Length`,

    nearest_natural_gaps =
      Gaps,

    nearest_natural_mismatches =
      Mismatches,

    nearest_natural_synonymous_substitutions =
      synonymous_substitutions,

    nearest_natural_nonsynonymous_substitutions =
      nonsynonymous_substitutions,

    nearest_natural_intergenic_substitutions =
      intergenic_substitutions,

    nearest_natural_indel_events =
      indel_events,

    nearest_natural_indel_total_nt =
      indel_total_nt,

    nearest_natural_total_mutation_events =
      total_mutation_events,

    nearest_natural_estimated_snv =
      estimated_snv
  )

evo_nearest_natural_top1 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_different = sum(
      nearest_natural_percent_identity !=
        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    max_difference = max(
      abs(
        nearest_natural_percent_identity -
          nearest_natural_sequence_similarity
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 2
#   n_different max_difference
#         <int>          <dbl>
# 1         270           96.8



# ============================================================
# Separate generated designs from recovered viable genomes
# ============================================================

evo_generated_nearest_natural <- evo_nearest_natural_top1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    category_original %in% c(
      "Viable generated",
      "Nonviable generated"
    )
  )

evo_generated_nearest_natural %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    n_unique_isolates =
      dplyr::n_distinct(isolate)
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 2
#   n_rows n_unique_isolates
#    <int>             <int>
# 1    302               302



# ============================================================
# Build master metadata table for all 302 Evo-designed genomes
# ============================================================

evo300_metadata <- evo_sheet1_raw %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Internal design identifiers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    design_number = dplyr::row_number(),

    design_id = sprintf(
      "EvoDesign_%03d",
      design_number
    ),

    original_design_id =
      synthesisbatch_model_parameters_prompt_id,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract published Evo-phage isolate number/name
    #
    # Example:
    # ..._genome_4_umi294
    #       ↓
    # Evo-Phi4
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    isolate_number = stringr::str_match(
      synthesisbatch_model_parameters_prompt_id,
      "genome_([0-9]+)_umi"
    )[, 2],

    isolate = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(isolate_number),
      paste0(
        "Evo-Phi",
        isolate_number
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Original rebooting phenotype
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    viability_original =
      post_rebooting_viability,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Binary biological viability
    #
    # DNA-synthesis failures are NA because those genomes
    # were not biologically tested for rebooting.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rebooting_viable = dplyr::case_when(

      post_rebooting_viability %in% c(
        "viable",
        "viable, acquired mutation(s) during rebooting"
      ) ~ TRUE,

      post_rebooting_viability == "nonviable" ~ FALSE,

      post_rebooting_viability ==
        "nonviable, failed DNA synthesis" ~ NA,

      TRUE ~ NA
    ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # More detailed phenotype flags
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    acquired_mutations_during_rebooting =
      post_rebooting_viability ==
      "viable, acquired mutation(s) during rebooting",

    failed_DNA_synthesis =
      post_rebooting_viability ==
      "nonviable, failed DNA synthesis",


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Simple viability category for plotting/reporting
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    viability_group = dplyr::case_when(

      post_rebooting_viability == "viable" ~
        "Viable",

      post_rebooting_viability ==
        "viable, acquired mutation(s) during rebooting" ~
        "Viable after acquired mutation(s)",

      post_rebooting_viability == "nonviable" ~
        "Nonviable",

      post_rebooting_viability ==
        "nonviable, failed DNA synthesis" ~
        "DNA synthesis failed",

      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::transmute(

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identifiers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    design_id,
    design_number,
    original_design_id,

    isolate,
    isolate_number,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Genome sequence
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    sequence,
    genome_length,
    gc_content,
    max_nt_homopolymer_length,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Genome / ORF annotation supplied by the authors
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    prodigal_orf_count,
    prodigal_orf_lengths,
    total_prodigal_orfs_length,
    prodigal_coding_density,
    max_prodigal_aa_homopolymer_len,

    protein_database_hit_count,
    checkv_quality,

    mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
    
    architecture_similarity_score,

    tropism_protein_mmseqs_target,
    tropism_protein_mmseqs_e_value,
    tropism_protein_mmseqs_percent_identity,

    average_protein_percent_identity,
    num_syntenic_genes,
    non_syntenic_genes,
    non_syntenic_annotations,
    total_num_genes,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Rebooting outcome
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    viability_original,
    viability_group,
    rebooting_viable,
    acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
    failed_DNA_synthesis
  )

evo300_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(design_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)
# A tibble: 0 × 2
# ℹ 2 variables: design_id <chr>, n <int>

evo300_metadata_stage1 <- evo300_metadata %>%

sheet5_secondary_lookup <-

# ============================================================
# Secondary join

evo300_stage2_matches <- evo300_metadata_stage1 %>%

)

# Supplement the sequence similarity bins used in the paper
evo300_metadata_final <- evo300_metadata_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    nearest_natural_similarity_bin =
      dplyr::case_when(

        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 98 &
          nearest_natural_sequence_similarity <= 100 ~
          "98–100",

        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 96 ~
          "96–98",

        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 94 ~
          "94–96",

        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 92 ~
          "92–94",

        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 90 ~
          "90–92",

        TRUE ~
          "<90"
      ),

    nearest_natural_similarity_bin =
      factor(
        nearest_natural_similarity_bin,
        levels = c(
          "<90",
          "90–92",
          "92–94",
          "94–96",
          "96–98",
          "98–100"
        )
      )
  )


# Reproduce their viability calculation
viability_by_nearest_natural_similarity <-
  evo300_metadata_final %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    !failed_DNA_synthesis,
    !is.na(rebooting_viable),
    nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 90
  ) %>%

  dplyr::group_by(
    nearest_natural_similarity_bin
  ) %>%

  dplyr::summarise(
    n_tested =
      dplyr::n(),

    n_viable =
      sum(rebooting_viable),

    n_nonviable =
      sum(!rebooting_viable),

    viability_rate =
      n_viable / n_tested,

    viability_percent =
      100 * viability_rate,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

viability_by_nearest_natural_similarity
```

### 2) Mutation calling and classification.
Batch-align all 302 genome sequences to the exact ΦX174 WT genome, call substitutions and indels, and produce a clean per-genome QC/summary table.
 - FUNCTION: align_and_call_nt_mutations(), validated in the 16 annotated viable genomes.
 - use $original_design_id as the unique key throughout, because some phage isolates share same indexes.
- evo300_alignment_results
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 2A. Prepare genome-alignment input
# ============================================================

evo300_alignment_input <- evo300_metadata_final %>%
  dplyr::select(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    sequence,
    genome_length,
    mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
    nearest_natural_sequence_similarity,
    nearest_natural_similarity_bin,
    architecture_similarity_score,
    viability_group,
    rebooting_viable,
    acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
    failed_DNA_synthesis
  )

dim(evo300_alignment_input)
# [1] 302   12

# QC
evo300_alignment_input %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genomes = dplyr::n(),
    n_unique_design_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(original_design_id),
    n_unique_sequences =
      dplyr::n_distinct(sequence)
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 3
#   n_genomes n_unique_design_ids n_unique_sequences

# ============================================================
# Step 2B. Safe wrapper around existing alignment function
# ============================================================

process_evo300_genome <- function(
    original_design_id,
    sequence
) {

  tryCatch(

    {

      result <- align_and_call_nt_mutations(
        reference_seq = phix174_reference$genome,
        query_seq = sequence,

        # Pass unique ID into legacy "isolate" argument
        isolate = original_design_id
      )

      list(
        original_design_id = original_design_id,
        success = TRUE,
        result = result,
        error = NA_character_
      )
    },

    error = function(e) {

      list(
        original_design_id = original_design_id,
        success = FALSE,
        result = NULL,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}
```

### 3) Summarise the mutation tables from evo300 genomes alignment
- evo300_nt_mutations
- evo300_alignment_QC
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 3A. Combine mutation calls from all 302 genomes
# ============================================================

evo300_nt_mutations <- purrr::map_dfr(
  evo300_alignment_results,
  function(x) {

    if (!x$success) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    mut <- x$result$mutations

    if (nrow(mut) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    mut %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        original_design_id =
          x$original_design_id,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

names(evo300_nt_mutations)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 4A. Create a substitution-only long table for DMS annotation.
# ============================================================

evo300_nt_substitutions <- evo300_nt_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type == "substitution"
  )

evo300_nt_substitutions %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    n_designs = dplyr::n_distinct(original_design_id),
    n_unique_mutations = dplyr::n_distinct(mutation_id)
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 3
#   n_rows n_designs n_unique_mutations
#    <int>     <int>              <int>
# 1 134382       302              15804



# ============================================================
# Step 4B. Join DMS onto all 302 substitutions.
# ============================================================

evo300_nt_analysis <- evo300_nt_substitutions %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    phix_nt_DMS_merge,
    by = c(
      "mutation_id" = "mutation_id"
    )
  )

evo300_nt_analysis <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DMS_available =
      !is.na(DMS_effect_category)
  )


# Add genomic context annotations
genomic_context_levels <- c(
  "Noncoding",
  "Single coding",
  "Overlapping coding",
  "DMS not covered"
)

evo300_nt_analysis <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    DMS_available =
      !is.na(DMS_effect_category),

    DMS_status =
      dplyr::if_else(
        DMS_available,
        "DMS covered",
        "DMS not covered"
      ),
    
    genomic_context_chr =
      dplyr::case_when(

        nucleotide_class ==
          "Overlapping Coding" ~
          "Overlapping coding",

        nucleotide_class ==
          "Coding" ~
          "Single coding",

        nucleotide_class ==
          "Noncoding" ~
          "Noncoding",

        TRUE ~
          "DMS not covered"
      ),

    genomic_context =
      factor(
        genomic_context_chr,
        levels = genomic_context_levels
      ),

    fitness_group =
      dplyr::case_when(

        DMS_effect_category %in% c(
          "Detrimental",
          "Strongly detrimental"
        ) ~ "Detrimental",
  
        DMS_effect_category %in% c(
          "Increased",
          "No effect"
        ) ~ "Non-detrimental",
        
        TRUE ~
          "DMS not covered"
      )
  )

# ============================================================
# Step 4C. NT mutational burden per designed genome
# ============================================================

table(evo300_nt_analysis$DMS_effect_category_lethal)
#            Increased            No effect          Detrimental Strongly detrimental 
#                 1339                76427                24598                31452 

evo300_nt_burden_by_design <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_design_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_nt_substitutions =
      dplyr::n(),

    n_nt_DMS =
      sum(
        DMS_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_nt_DMS_not_covered =
      sum(
        !DMS_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    prop_nt_DMS_covered =
      n_nt_DMS /
      n_nt_substitutions,

    n_nt_beneficial =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Increased",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_nt_neutral =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "No effect",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_nt_detrimental =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Detrimental",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_nt_lethal =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Strongly detrimental",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_nt_deleterious =
      n_nt_detrimental +
      n_nt_lethal,

    n_nt_non_detrimental =
      n_nt_beneficial +
      n_nt_neutral,

    prop_nt_detrimental =
      dplyr::if_else(
        n_nt_DMS > 0,
        n_nt_detrimental /
          n_nt_DMS,
        NA_real_
      ),

    prop_nt_lethal =
      dplyr::if_else(
        n_nt_DMS > 0,
        n_nt_lethal /
          n_nt_DMS,
        NA_real_
      ),

    prop_nt_deleterious =
      dplyr::if_else(
        n_nt_DMS > 0,
        n_nt_deleterious /
          n_nt_DMS,
        NA_real_
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

names(evo300_nt_burden_by_design)
#  [1] "original_design_id"   "n_nt_substitutions"   "n_nt_DMS"             "n_nt_DMS_not_covered" "prop_nt_DMS_covered"  "n_nt_beneficial"      "n_nt_neutral"         "n_nt_detrimental"     "n_nt_lethal"         
# [10] "n_nt_deleterious"     "n_nt_non_detrimental" "prop_nt_detrimental"  "prop_nt_lethal"       "prop_nt_deleterious" 


# ============================================================
# Noncoding NT burden
# ============================================================

evo300_noncoding_burden <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    genomic_context == "Noncoding",
    DMS_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_design_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_noncoding_DMS =
      dplyr::n(),

    n_noncoding_beneficial =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Increased",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_noncoding_neutral =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "No effect",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_noncoding_detrimental =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Detrimental",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_noncoding_lethal =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal == "Strongly detrimental",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_noncoding_deleterious =
      n_noncoding_detrimental +
      n_noncoding_lethal,

    n_noncoding_non_detrimental =
      n_noncoding_beneficial +
      n_noncoding_neutral,

    prop_noncoding_deleterious =
      dplyr::if_else(
        n_noncoding_DMS > 0,
        n_noncoding_deleterious /
          n_noncoding_DMS,
        NA_real_
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

names(evo300_noncoding_burden)
# [1] "original_design_id"          "n_noncoding_DMS"             "n_noncoding_beneficial"      "n_noncoding_neutral"         "n_noncoding_detrimental"     "n_noncoding_lethal"          "n_noncoding_deleterious"    
# [8] "n_noncoding_non_detrimental" "prop_noncoding_deleterious" 


# ============================================================
# Final per-design mutational-burden table
# ============================================================

evo300_mutational_burden <- evo300_metadata_final %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_alignment_QC %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,

        reference_length,
        query_length,
        aligned_length,
        alignment_score,

        n_substitutions,
        n_insertions,
        n_deletions,

        inserted_nt,
        deleted_nt
      ),
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_nt_burden_by_design,
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_noncoding_burden,
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    has_insertion =
      n_insertions > 0,

    has_deletion =
      n_deletions > 0,

    has_indel =
      has_insertion |
      has_deletion,

    substitution_only =
      !has_indel
  )

# QC after all the merge steps above
```

### 4) Evo 300 genomes viability analysis
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 5A. Make the viability-analysis dataset
# ============================================================

evo300_viability_analysis <- evo300_mutational_burden %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !failed_DNA_synthesis,
    !is.na(rebooting_viable)
  )

evo300_viability_analysis %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rebooting_viable
  )

# # A tibble: 2 × 2
#   rebooting_viable     n
#   <lgl>            <int>
# 1 FALSE              269
# 2 TRUE                16


n_viable_tested <- evo300_viability_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(rebooting_viable) %>%
  nrow()
# [1] 16

n_nonviable_tested <- evo300_viability_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(!rebooting_viable) %>%
  nrow()
# [1] 269


# Check the genome alignment similarity
evo300_viability_analysis %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    rebooting_viable
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),

    min_identity =
      min(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Q1_identity =
      quantile(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        0.25,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_identity =
      median(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_identity =
      mean(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Q3_identity =
      quantile(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        0.75,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    max_identity =
      max(
        mmseqs_percent_identity_to_phix174,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# # A tibble: 2 × 8
#   rebooting_viable     n min_identity Q1_identity median_identity mean_identity Q3_identity max_identity
#   <lgl>            <int>        <dbl>       <dbl>           <dbl>         <dbl>       <dbl>        <dbl>
# 1 FALSE              269         60.2        78.6            90.4          87.1        94.7        100  
# 2 TRUE                16         88.7        94.6            97.0          96.0        97.7         98.5


# Use the corrected nearest-natural similarity [Updated from the sheet 5]
viability_by_nearest_natural_similarity <-
  evo300_viability_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    nearest_natural_sequence_similarity >= 90
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    nearest_natural_similarity_bin
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_tested =
      dplyr::n(),

    n_viable =
      sum(rebooting_viable),

    n_nonviable =
      sum(!rebooting_viable),

    viability_rate =
      n_viable /
      n_tested,

    viability_percent =
      100 *
      viability_rate,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

viability_by_nearest_natural_similarity

# ============================================================
# Step 5C. Make a mutation-frequency table across the 302 designs
# ============================================================

# How often is each specific ΦX174 substitution found among designed genomes?

evo300_mutation_frequency <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type == "substitution",
    DMS_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_design_id,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    mutation_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    
    n_designs = dplyr::n_distinct(
      original_design_id
    ),

    n_viable = dplyr::n_distinct(
      original_design_id[
        rebooting_viable %in% TRUE
      ]
    ),

    n_nonviable = dplyr::n_distinct(
      original_design_id[
        rebooting_viable %in% FALSE
      ]
    ),

    DMS_effect_category =
      dplyr::first(
        DMS_effect_category
      ),

    fitness_group =
      dplyr::first(
        fitness_group
      ),

    genomic_context =
      dplyr::first(
        genomic_context
      ),
    
    frequency_all_designs =
      n_designs / 302,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_designs)
  )

# Add viable/nonviable mutation frequencies
evo300_mutation_frequency <- evo300_mutation_frequency %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    freq_viable =
      n_viable / n_viable_tested,

    freq_nonviable =
      n_nonviable / n_nonviable_tested,

    frequency_difference =
      freq_viable - freq_nonviable
  )



# ============================================================
# Step 5D. Build exactly the per-phage mutation-category table
# ============================================================

evo300_effect_counts_by_design <- evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    DMS_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_design_id,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_design_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_DMS = dplyr::n(),

    n_beneficial =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category == "Increased repilcation"
      ),

    n_neutral =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category == "No measurable effect"
      ),

    n_detrimental =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category == "Reduced replication"
      ),

    n_lethal =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category == "Strongly detrimental"
      ),

    n_deleterious =
      n_detrimental +
      n_lethal,

    n_non_detrimental =
      n_beneficial +
      n_neutral,

    prop_detrimental =
      n_detrimental / n_DMS,

    prop_lethal =
      n_lethal / n_DMS,

    prop_deleterious =
      n_deleterious / n_DMS,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_metadata_final %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        isolate,
        viability_group,
        rebooting_viable,
        genome_length,
        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity,
        nearest_natural_similarity_bin,
        architecture_similarity_score
      ),
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_alignment_QC %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        n_substitutions,
        n_insertions,
        n_deletions,
        inserted_nt,
        deleted_nt
      ),
    by = "original_design_id"
  )

  ) %>%

        DMS_fitness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    min_DMS_fitness =

        DMS_fitness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_DMS_effect_size =
      mean(
        DMS_effect_size,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_DMS_effect_size =
      median(
        DMS_effect_size,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    min_DMS_effect_size =
      min(
        DMS_effect_size,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    # detrimental + lethal only
    mean_deleterious_fitness =
      mean(
        DMS_fitness[
          DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
            #c("Reduced replication", "Strongly detrimental")
            c("Detrimental", "Strongly detrimental")

      ),

    median_deleterious_fitness =
      median(
        DMS_fitness[
          DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
            #c("Reduced replication", "Strongly detrimental")

        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    min_deleterious_fitness =
      min(
        DMS_fitness[
          DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
            #c("Reduced replication", "Strongly detrimental")

        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_deleterious_effect_size =
      mean(
        DMS_effect_size[
          DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
            #c("Reduced replication", "Strongly detrimental")
            c("Detrimental", "Strongly detrimental")
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_deleterious_effect_size =
      median(
        DMS_effect_size[
          DMS_effect_category %in%
            #c("Reduced replication", "Strongly detrimental")
            c("Detrimental", "Strongly detrimental")
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ dplyr::if_else(

        .x,
        NA_real_
```

```{r}
    original_design_id,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_design_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_DMS_effects = dplyr::n(),

    # Sum of all single-mutant effects
    # beneficial effects can offset detrimental effects
    sum_DMS_effect_size =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_size,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    # Sum of fitness-reducing effects only
    sum_negative_DMS_effect_size =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_size[
          DMS_effect_size < 0
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    # Mean effect
    #mean_DMS_effect_size =
      #mean(
        #DMS_effect_size,
        #na.rm = TRUE
      #),

    # Median effect
    #median_DMS_effect_size =
      #median(
        #DMS_effect_size,
        #na.rm = TRUE
      #),

    # Worst individual mutation
    #min_DMS_effect_size =
      #min(
        #DMS_effect_size,
        #na.rm = TRUE
      #),

    # Positive-valued "burden":
    # larger number = larger accumulated fitness cost
    cumulative_fitness_cost =
      sum(
        pmax(
          -DMS_effect_size,
          0
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



# ============================================================
# Build one integrated predictor table
# ============================================================

evo300_viability_predictors <- evo300_mutational_burden_final %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_continuous_fitness_summary,
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    evo300_cumulative_DMS_scores,
    by = "original_design_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    n_indel_events =
      n_insertions +
      n_deletions,

    indel_nt_burden =
      inserted_nt +
      deleted_nt
  )

head(as.data.frame(evo300_viability_predictors), 0)


# Predictor performance analysis 
evo300_predictor_analysis <- evo300_viability_predictors %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !failed_DNA_synthesis, # remove those failed in DNA synthesis
    !is.na(rebooting_viable)
  )

evo300_predictor_analysis %>%
  dplyr::count(
    viability_group,
    rebooting_viable
  )

#   <chr>                             <lgl>            <int>
# 1 Nonviable                         FALSE              269
# 2 Viable                            TRUE                 9
# 3 Viable after acquired mutation(s) TRUE                 7
```

```{r}
    acquired_mutations_during_rebooting
  ) %>%

rescued_design_mapping %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

# Mutations in designed genomes

rescued_designed_mutations <- evo300_nt_mutations %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(

# ============================================================
# Recovered viable-genome mutations
# Extract directly from evo_phage_analysis

rescued_recovered_mutations <- purrr::map_dfr(
  rescued_design_mapping$isolate,

  function(x) {

      )
  }
)

rescued_recovered_mutations <- rescued_recovered_mutations %>%

rescued_recovered_mutations %>%

# ============================================================
# First summarize designed vs recovered mutation counts
# Show whether rebooting mainly involved substitutions or also altered indels.
# ============================================================

rescued_mutation_count_QC <- dplyr::full_join(

    isolate,
    mutation_type
  )

rescued_mutation_count_QC

# ============================================================
# Then classify identified mutations
# ============================================================

designed_subs <- rescued_designed_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type == "substitution"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_design_id,
    ref_start,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

recovered_subs <- rescued_recovered_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type == "substitution"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    original_design_id,
    ref_start,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# 1) Retained substitutions
retained_subs <- designed_subs %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    recovered_subs %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    genome_position = as.integer(ref_start),

    WT_allele = ref_allele,
    designed_allele = alt_allele,
    recovered_allele = alt_allele,

    designed_mutation_id = mutation_id,
    recovered_mutation_id = mutation_id,

    rebooting_change = "Retained"
  )

# 2) Designed mutations that disappeared
designed_not_retained <- designed_subs %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    recovered_subs %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id"
    )
  )

# 3) Recovered mutations absent from the design
recovered_not_designed <- recovered_subs %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    designed_subs %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id"
    )
  )

# 4) Detect secondary mutation changes (for example, wt = G, design = A, but recovered = T)
# At the same WT coordinate but with a different mutant allele.
changed_allele_subs <- designed_not_retained %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    recovered_not_designed %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        ref_start,
        recovered_alt_allele = alt_allele,
        recovered_mutation_id = mutation_id
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "ref_start"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    genome_position = as.integer(ref_start),

    WT_allele = ref_allele,
    designed_allele = alt_allele,
    recovered_allele = recovered_alt_allele,

    designed_mutation_id = mutation_id,
    recovered_mutation_id,

    rebooting_change =
      "Changed allele"
  )

# 5) Identify true reversions to WT
reversion_subs <- designed_not_retained %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    recovered_not_designed %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        original_design_id,
        ref_start
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "ref_start"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    genome_position = as.integer(ref_start),

    WT_allele = ref_allele,
    designed_allele = alt_allele,
    recovered_allele = ref_allele,

    designed_mutation_id = mutation_id,
    recovered_mutation_id = NA_character_,

    rebooting_change =
      "Reversion to WT"
  )

# 6) Identify genuinely new substitutions
new_subs <- recovered_not_designed %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    designed_not_retained %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        original_design_id,
        ref_start
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "ref_start"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    genome_position = as.integer(ref_start),

    WT_allele = ref_allele,
    designed_allele = ref_allele,
    recovered_allele = alt_allele,

    designed_mutation_id = NA_character_,
    recovered_mutation_id = mutation_id,

    rebooting_change =
      "New mutation"
  )

# 7) Combine all substitution states
rescued_substitution_changes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  retained_subs,
  new_subs,
  reversion_subs,
  changed_allele_subs
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rescued_design_mapping %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity
      ),
    by = "original_design_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    isolate,
    genome_position
  )

names(rescued_substitution_changes)

rescued_substitution_changes %>%
  dplyr::count(
    isolate,
    rebooting_change
  )

# 8) Handle indels separately
designed_indels <- rescued_designed_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type %in%
      c(
        "insertion",
        "deletion"
      )
  )

recovered_indels <- rescued_recovered_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type %in%
      c(
        "insertion",
        "deletion"
      )
  )

retained_indels <- designed_indels %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    recovered_indels %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id_full
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id_full"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rebooting_change =
      "Retained indel"
  )
# Retained-indel table is empty

lost_indels <- designed_indels %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    recovered_indels %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id_full
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id_full"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rebooting_change =
      "Lost designed indel"
  )

acquired_indels <- recovered_indels %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    designed_indels %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        mutation_id_full
      ),
    by = c(
      "original_design_id",
      "mutation_id_full"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rebooting_change =
      "Acquired indel"
  )

# combine indels analysis
rescued_indel_changes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  retained_indels,
  lost_indels,
  acquired_indels
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(

  )

rescued_indel_changes %>%
```

## Summary and Visualize mutational effects in evo 300 genomes

### 1) Mutation Categories (Fig. S8, B and C; Bar Plots; Dot Plots;)
```{r}
# check data
head(as.data.frame(evo300_nt_analysis), 0)
table(evo300_nt_analysis$DMS_effect_category)
# Increased replication  No measurable effect   Reduced replication 
#                  1339                 76427                 56050 

head(as.data.frame(evo300_viability_predictors), 0)
names(evo300_viability_predictors)


# Panel A — fraction of deleterious SNVs per genome
# 1) detrimental mutations
evo300_panelA_data <-
  evo300_viability_predictors %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !failed_DNA_synthesis,
    !is.na(rebooting_viable),
    !is.na(prop_nt_deleterious),
    !is.na(nearest_natural_similarity_bin)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    viability_state =
      dplyr::case_when(
        rebooting_viable &
          acquired_mutations_during_rebooting ~
          "Viable after acquired mutation(s)",

        rebooting_viable ~
          "Viable",

        TRUE ~
          "Nonviable"
      ),

    nearest_natural_similarity_bin =
      factor(
        nearest_natural_similarity_bin,
        levels = c(

# 2) only strongly detrimental mutations
evo300_panelA_data <-

# Panel B — fraction of genomes containing ≥1 strongly detrimental SNV
evo300_strongly_detrimental_by_genome <-
  evo300_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
```

### 2) Correlations with lytic performance (Fig. S8D; Scatter Plots;)
Here we compare growth rates to the viable genotypes. (after acquiring rebooting mutations)
```{r}

# 1) Define the 16 viable isolates

# 8) Add genotype-source labels
evo16_actual_viable_mutations <-
  evo16_actual_viable_mutations %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    evo16_genotype_source %>%
      dplyr::select(
        original_design_id,
        acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity
      ),
    by = "original_design_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    genotype_source =
      dplyr::if_else(
        acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
        "Recovered viable genotype",
        "Designed viable genotype"
      )
  )


# 9) Recalculate the extended DMS predictors
evo16_DMS_predictors_actual <-
  evo16_actual_viable_mutations %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    DMS_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    original_design_id,
    isolate,
    acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
    nearest_natural_sequence_similarity,
    genotype_source
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_DMS_SNV =
      dplyr::n(),

    # all detrimental
    n_detrimental =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
          c(
            #"Reduced replication",
            "Detrimental",
            "Strongly detrimental"
          ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    prop_detrimental =
      n_detrimental /
      n_DMS_SNV,

    median_fitness_detrimental = {

      x <- DMS_fitness[
        DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
          c(
            #"Reduced replication",
            "Detrimental",
            "Strongly detrimental"
          )
      ]

      if (length(x) == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        stats::median(
          x,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }
    },

    mean_fitness_detrimental = {

      x <- DMS_fitness[
        DMS_effect_category_lethal %in%
          c(
            #"Reduced replication",
            "Detrimental",
            "Strongly detrimental"
          )
      ]

      if (length(x) == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        mean(
          x,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }
    },

    # strongly detrimental only
    n_strongly_detrimental =
      sum(
        DMS_effect_category_lethal ==
          "Strongly detrimental",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    prop_strongly_detrimental =
      n_strongly_detrimental /
      n_DMS_SNV,

    median_fitness_strongly_detrimental = {

      x <- DMS_fitness[
        DMS_effect_category_lethal ==
          "Strongly detrimental"
      ]

      if (length(x) == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        stats::median(
          x,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }
    },

    # global severity summaries
    min_DMS_fitness =
      min(
        DMS_fitness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_DMS_fitness =
      stats::median(
        DMS_fitness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_DMS_fitness =
      mean(
        DMS_fitness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

evo16_spearman_actual <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    names(candidate_predictors),

    ~ run_spearman_one(

# 12) scatter plots and optimize the layout
# Define the 8 predictors and the panel labels
plot_spec_8 <- tibble::tibble(

  predictor = c(
    "n_detrimental",
    "prop_detrimental",
    "median_fitness_detrimental",
    "n_strongly_detrimental",
    "prop_strongly_detrimental",
    "median_fitness_strongly_detrimental",
    "min_DMS_fitness",
    "nearest_natural_sequence_similarity"
  ),

  panel_group = c(
    "Detrimental",
    "Detrimental",
    "Detrimental",
    "Strongly detrimental",
    "Strongly detrimental",
    "Strongly detrimental",
    "Whole-DMS data",
    "Baseline"
  ),

  panel_metric = c(
    "Number",
    "Fraction",
    "Median fitness",
    "Number",
    "Fraction",
    "Median fitness",
    "Minimum fitness",
    "Similarity (%)"
  )

) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    panel_label =
      paste0(
        panel_group,
        "\n",
        panel_metric
      ),
    panel_order =
      dplyr::row_number()
  )

# Build one long-format plotting data frame
evo16_scatter_long <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_len(nrow(plot_spec_8)),
    function(i) {

      this_predictor <-
        plot_spec_8$predictor[i]

      this_group <-
        plot_spec_8$panel_group[i]

      this_metric <-
        plot_spec_8$panel_metric[i]

      this_label <-
        plot_spec_8$panel_label[i]

      this_order <-
        plot_spec_8$panel_order[i]

      evo16_correlation_data_actual %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          isolate,
          genotype_source,
          acquired_mutations_during_rebooting,
          lytic_rank_Evo,
          GrowthRateMin_mean,
          predictor = this_predictor,
          panel_group = this_group,
          panel_metric = this_metric,
          panel_label = this_label,
          panel_order = this_order,
          x = .data[[this_predictor]]
        )
    }
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    viability_display =
      dplyr::case_when(
        acquired_mutations_during_rebooting ~
          "Viable after acquired mutation(s)",
        TRUE ~
          "Viable"
      ),

    panel_label =
      factor(
        panel_label,
        levels =
          plot_spec_8$panel_label
      )
  )

names(evo16_scatter_long)

# [11] "x"                                   "viability_display"                  

# check plotting data
evo16_scatter_long %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),

    min_growth = min(GrowthRateMin_mean, na.rm = TRUE),

  )

evo16_scatter_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(panel_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_complete = sum(
      is.finite(x) &
      is.finite(GrowthRateMin_mean)
    ),
    min_x = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_x = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_growth = min(GrowthRateMin_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_growth = max(GrowthRateMin_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# # A tibble: 8 × 7
#   panel_label                                n n_complete   min_x   max_x min_growth max_growth
#   <fct>                                  <int>      <int>   <dbl>   <dbl>      <dbl>      <dbl>
# 1 "Detrimental\nNumber"                     16         16  3      24         -0.0129   -0.00550
# 2 "Detrimental\nFraction"                   16         16  0.0417  0.149     -0.0129   -0.00550
# 3 "Detrimental\nMedian fitness"             16         16  0.700   0.861     -0.0129   -0.00550
# 4 "Strongly detrimental\nNumber"            16         16  0       6         -0.0129   -0.00550
# 5 "Strongly detrimental\nFraction"          16         16  0       0.0335    -0.0129   -0.00550
# 6 "Strongly detrimental\nMedian fitness"    16          9 -0.108   0.435     -0.0129   -0.00550
# 7 "Whole-DMS data\nMinimum fitness"         16         16 -0.108   0.633     -0.0129   -0.00550
# 8 "Baseline\nSimilarity (%)"                16         16 93.2    98.8       -0.0129   -0.00550



# ============================================================
# Recalculate Spearman correlations against GrowthRateMin_mean
# Spearman correlations with observed lytic performance
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 1) Fix the panel order
# ============================================================

desired_panel_order <- c(
  "Detrimental\nNumber",
  "Detrimental\nFraction",
  "Detrimental\nMedian fitness",
  "Whole-DMS data\nMinimum fitness",
  "Strongly detrimental\nNumber",
  "Strongly detrimental\nFraction",
  "Strongly detrimental\nMedian fitness",
  "Baseline\nSimilarity (%)"
)

evo16_scatter_long <- evo16_scatter_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    panel_label = factor(
      panel_label,
      levels = desired_panel_order
    )
  )

evo16_scatter_plot_data <-
  evo16_scatter_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    panel_label = factor(
      panel_label,
      levels = desired_panel_order
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(x),
    is.finite(GrowthRateMin_mean)
  )

names(evo16_scatter_plot_data)
#  [1] "isolate"                             "genotype_source"                     "acquired_mutations_during_rebooting" "lytic_rank_Evo"                      "GrowthRateMin_mean"                 
#  [6] "predictor"                           "panel_group"                         "panel_metric"                        "panel_label"                         "panel_order"                        
# [11] "x"                                   "viability_display"                  

# Then calculate a common y-position above the points


# ============================================================
# 2. Define common y-range and annotation position
# ============================================================

growth_min <-
  min(
    evo16_scatter_plot_data$GrowthRateMin_mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

growth_max <-
  max(
    evo16_scatter_plot_data$GrowthRateMin_mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

growth_range <- growth_max - growth_min

# Put statistics above all observed points
stats_y_pos <-
  growth_max + 0.12 * growth_range


# Now rebuild the Spearman statistics

# ============================================================
# 3. Calculate Spearman correlations
# ============================================================

evo16_scatter_stats <-
  evo16_scatter_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    predictor,
    panel_group,
    panel_metric,
    panel_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n = dplyr::n(),

    rho = {
      if (
        dplyr::n_distinct(x) > 1 &&
        dplyr::n_distinct(GrowthRateMin_mean) > 1
      ) {
        suppressWarnings(
          stats::cor(
            x,
            GrowthRateMin_mean,
            method = "spearman"
          )
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },

    p_value = {
      if (
        dplyr::n_distinct(x) > 1 &&
        dplyr::n_distinct(GrowthRateMin_mean) > 1
      ) {
        suppressWarnings(
          stats::cor.test(
            x,
            GrowthRateMin_mean,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )$p.value
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },

    x_min = min(x),
    x_max = max(x),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    x_range = x_max - x_min,

    # Right side of each panel
    x_pos =
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(x_range) & x_range > 0,
        x_max - 0.03 * x_range,
        x_max
      ),

    # Same reserved position above all points
    y_pos = stats_y_pos,

    stat_label =
      paste0(
        "Spearman \u03C1 = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", rho),
        "\nP = ",
        format.pval(
          p_value,
          digits = 2,
          eps = 0.001
        ),
        ", n = ",
        n
      )
  )

# This produces labels such as 
# Spearman ρ = -0.59
# P = 0.017, n = 16

names(evo16_scatter_stats)
# [1] "predictor"    "panel_group"  "panel_metric" "panel_label"  "n"            "rho"          "p_value"      "x_min"        "x_max"        "x_range"      "x_pos"        "y_pos"        "stat_label"  

evo16_scatter_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(
    panel_label,
    n,
    rho,
    p_value
  )
# # A tibble: 8 × 4
#   panel_label                                n    rho p_value
#   <fct>                                  <int>  <dbl>   <dbl>
# 1 "Detrimental\nMedian fitness"             16  0.136  0.616 
# 2 "Strongly detrimental\nMedian fitness"     9 -0.55   0.125 
# 3 "Whole-DMS data\nMinimum fitness"         16 -0.587  0.0168
# 4 "Detrimental\nNumber"                     16  0.407  0.118 
# 5 "Strongly detrimental\nNumber"            16  0.331  0.211 
# 6 "Baseline\nSimilarity (%)"                16 -0.168  0.535 
# 7 "Detrimental\nFraction"                   16  0.429  0.0969
# 8 "Strongly detrimental\nFraction"          16  0.409  0.116 



# ============================================================
# 4. Final 4 × 2 correlation plot
# ============================================================

p_evo16_correlation_panel <-
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    evo16_scatter_plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x,
      y = GrowthRateMin_mean
    )
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(
      fill = viability_display
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    stroke = 0.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Correlation statistics in reserved space above the points
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = evo16_scatter_stats,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = y_pos,
      label = stat_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.1,
    lineheight = 1.05
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Viable" = "#A8D5A2",
      "Viable after acquired mutation(s)" = "#F2C879"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  # Add enough upper space for the statistical annotation
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      growth_min - 0.03 * growth_range,
      growth_max + 0.20 * growth_range
    ),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +

  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ panel_label,
    ncol = 4,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +

  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = paste0(
      "Steepest host growth decline\n",
      "(more negative = stronger lytic performance)"
    ),
    title =
      "Associations between mutational metrics and lytic performance"
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme(

    legend.position = "bottom",

    strip.background =
      ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = "gray90",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),

    strip.text =
      ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 9.5,
        lineheight = 1.0
      ),

    axis.title.x =
      ggplot2::element_blank(),

    axis.text.x =
      ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 8.5
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 8.5
      ),

    axis.title.y =
      ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 10.5
      ),

    plot.title =
      ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),

    plot.title.position = "plot",

    panel.spacing =
      grid::unit(
        0.35,
        "lines"
      )
  )

p_evo16_correlation_panel
```

```{r}
# Confirm the naming convention to be standardized
standardize_DMS_category <- function(x) {

  dplyr::case_when(

    x %in% c(
      "Increased replication",
      "Increased",
      "Beneficial"
    ) ~
      "Increased",

    x %in% c(
      "No measurable effect",
      "No effect",
      "Neutral"
    ) ~
      "No effect",

    x %in% c(
      "Reduced replication",
      "Detrimental"
    ) ~
      "Detrimental",

    x %in% c(
      "Strongly detrimental",
      "Lethal"
    ) ~
      "Strongly detrimental",

    TRUE ~
      "DMS not covered"
  )
}

heatmap_rescue_events <-
  heatmap_rescue_events %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Standardized DMS categories
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    designed_DMS_category_plot =
      standardize_DMS_category(
        designed_DMS_effect_category
      ),

    recovered_DMS_category_plot =
      standardize_DMS_category(
        recovered_DMS_effect_category
      ),


    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Mutation ID used for the rebooting symbol
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    plot_mutation_id =
      dplyr::case_when(

        rebooting_change_plot ==
          "Reversion to WT" ~
          designed_mutation_id,

        rebooting_change_plot ==
          "New mutation" ~
          recovered_mutation_id,

        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
      ),


    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Position
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    genome_position_numeric =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          genome_position
        )
      )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      plot_mutation_id
    )
  )

# Make sure genome_position is numeric 
heatmap_rescue_events <-
  heatmap_rescue_events %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    genome_position_numeric =
      dplyr::coalesce(

        suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(
            genome_position
          )
        ),

        as.integer(
          stringr::str_extract(
            plot_mutation_id,
            "[0-9]+"
          )
        )
      )
  )

# 10) add ALL designed mutations that changed during rebooting

        lytic_rank_Evo,
        nearest_natural_sequence_similarity

    by =

    relationship =
      "many-to-one"

    relationship =
      "many-to-one"

  dplyr::mutate(

    designed_DMS_category_plot =
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(
          designed_DMS_category_plot

        "No displayed designed mutation",
        designed_DMS_category_plot
      ),

    mutation_id =
      factor(
        mutation_id,
        levels =
          heatmap_mutation_order
      ),

    heatmap_label =
      factor(
        heatmap_label,
        levels =
          rev(
            heatmap_row_order
          )
      )
  )

p_combined_heatmap_fitness <-
  ggplot2::ggplot(

  # ========================================================

  ggplot2::geom_tile(

    linewidth = 0.12
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data =

        !is.na(

        )
      ),

    ggplot2::aes(
      fill =
        designed_DMS_fitness
    ),

    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.12
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors =
      replication_colors,

    values =
      scales::rescale(
        replication_breaks
      ),

      c(

        1.5
      ),

      scales::squish,

      ggplot2::guide_colorbar(

      )

  # ========================================================

  ggplot2::geom_point(

        16,

      "Reversion to WT" =
        4
    ),

  ) +

  # ========================================================

  ggplot2::facet_grid(

    space = "free_y"

  # Mutation labels on top
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
    position = "top"

  ggplot2::labs(

      ),
```
